# The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-ppmsca-44953
Voiceover: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CA01-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · SEE — Who is actually in the institution?. Begin with people and entities, not an idealized org chart. Record each role, the work performed, employment or contracting status if verified, jurisdiction, decision authority, dependencies, and the evidence supporting the entry. Unknown must remain unknown.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA01-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · HAND OFF — What crosses between them?. A sketch, toile, pattern, specification, fitting note, approval, image, sample, purchase order, credential, or verbal correction carries different kinds of knowledge. Bind every consequential handoff to a named sender, receiver, version, decision, deadline, and return path.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA01-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · CREDIT — Whose labor becomes visible?. Public credit, legal authorship, ownership, compensation, and cultural recognition are different fields. Preserve the contributor’s preferred name and role while separately recording the governing contract or policy and any disputed or omitted attribution.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA01-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · TEST POWER — Who can stop, change, approve, or leave?. Map vetoes, approvals, revision burdens, payment triggers, confidentiality, reuse, termination, safety escalation, archive access, and correction. A glamorous credit list without decision and remedy fields can still hide the institution.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
